description: Displace a supplied graph synchronously along sufficiently long edges, using reciprocal unit vectors.
output_invariants: Detached finite canonical data; stable identity/order as specified; no partial result on failure.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype records, dense ordinary arrays with own data slots, no classes/accessors/symbols/extras/coercion; proxies outside interchange. Numeric values finite binary64; booleans never numbers. Validate complete input in input-schema field order, arrays in order, then correspondence/topology structure, then exact-integer work preflight before geometric predicates or result allocation. Normalize accepted/exposed zero to +0. Inputs unchanged and all outputs deeply detached. Host allocation failure remains a host error.
behavior.environment: No RNG, clock, renderer or assets. Caller Cartesian coordinates; signed turns use algebraic counterclockwise orientation in x/y coordinates, visually clockwise when y points down. Explicit caller dt where present. p5-only initial delivery; no physical collision, source solver or other-target equivalence.
behavior.numerics: Binary64 separately rounded primitives, no FMA or reassociation. Check each computed floating arithmetic primitive finite or NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. Exact dyadic/rational predicates use existing internal/exact-rational.js without converting before classification. Existing fdlibmHypot and fdlibmAtan2 profiles for stated norms/angles. Compare IDs, topology, ordering, counters and errors exactly; analytical floating fixtures may explicitly allow absolute1e-12 relative0. No global epsilon.
behavior.correspondence: pinned length N. pairs have 0<=i<j<N in strict lexicographic order, without duplicates. Check every pair and pin before work. Pair indices are array indices, not arbitrary persistent IDs.
behavior.work: N=points.length,P=pairs.length; W=N+P in exact integers, precharged. O(N+P) work/storage.
behavior.algorithm: Initialize sums [0,0]. For each pair compute dx=xj-xi,dy=yj-yi,L=fdlibmHypot(dx,dy), checking all finite even if stepScale0. If L>minLength, ux=dx/L then uy=dy/L; add sum_i.x+=ux,sum_i.y+=uy,sum_j.x-=ux,sum_j.y-=uy in that order. Otherwise no contribution; zero length never passes nonnegative threshold. All pairs use old points. Visit points ascending: compute displacement x=stepScale*sum.x then y=stepScale*sum.y, checking finite before pin override. If pinned set both displacement components0. Compute output x=oldX+dx then y=oldY+dy. Canonicalize outputs. No degree normalization, velocity, damping, rest length, boundary or hidden clock.
behavior.native_surface: thresholdEdgeRelaxation2D(input), ThresholdEdgeRelaxation2DError; threshold-edge-relaxation-2d.js and package index.

errors.WORK_LIMIT: Exact declared work reservation exceeds maxWork.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Nonfinite checked arithmetic; no partial result.
